name: Echo: Benefits
source:
Originally posted on Patreon as "Bonus Story #5 - Benefits". This is a short VN centered around the characters Flynn and Carl from Echo. It is recommended that you play Echo first before experiencing this VN.

[From [url=https://echoproject.itch.io/echo-benefits]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最初发布在Patreon上，标题为“奖励故事#5 - 好处”。这是一个简短的VN，以《Echo》中的角色弗林和卡尔为中心。建议你先玩一下Echo再体验这个VN。

[来自[url=https://echoproject.itch.io/echo-benefits]itch.io[/url]]
